title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 22: the burden of the valley of vision, feasting instead of weeping, Shebna the treasurer, and Eliakim with the key of David's house.

questions.text: Isaiah 22 is called the burden of what?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 opens with "The burden of the valley of vision."

questions.text: Where have all the people gone up, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 asks, "What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?"

questions.text: How does verse 2 describe the city's slain?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says, "your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle."

answers.text: Slain by famine in the siege

questions.text: Who carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, "Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield."

questions.text: What did the people see were many in David's city?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says, "You saw the breaches of David's city, that they were many," and they gathered the waters of the lower pool.

questions.text: Why did they break down the houses of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says they counted the houses of Jerusalem and broke down the houses to fortify the wall.

answers.text: To build the king a palace

questions.text: Instead of weeping, what did the people say as they ate and drank?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says there was joy and gladness, killing cattle and sheep, "Let's eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die."

answers.text: "Peace and safety belong to us forever"
"The Lord has delivered us from our enemies"
"Let's eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die"
"Tomorrow we will fight and take the spoil"

questions.text: Which treasurer, who is over the house, is the prophet sent to?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says, "Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house."

questions.text: Whom will Yahweh call his servant and clothe with Shebna's robe?
questions.explanation: Verses 20-21 say Yahweh will call his servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah and clothe him with the robe and belt.

questions.text: What will be laid on Eliakim's shoulder?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says, "I will lay the key of David's house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut."

answers.text: The robe of the high priest
